verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for a SaaS work-management product like ClickUp, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of any telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking opt-out control. The only on-topic item is a community remark that the app is 'packed with trackers', which describes the problem rather than any opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
